SELECT pr.id AS request_id, pr.request_number, pr.title, pr.status, applicant.display_name AS applicant_name, pr.department_id, COALESCE(pr.department_name_snapshot, department.name) AS department_name, summary.product_name AS item_summary, GREATEST(summary.item_count - 1, 0)::INTEGER AS additional_item_count, COALESCE(po.actual_supplier_id, pr.requested_supplier_id) AS supplier_id, COALESCE(po.actual_supplier_name_snapshot, pr.requested_supplier_name_snapshot, supplier.name) AS supplier_name, CASE WHEN po.id IS NULL THEN summary.planned_total ELSE summary.actual_total END AS total_amount, COALESCE(ad.decided_at, pr.updated_at) AS approved_at, pr.desired_delivery_date, pr.version FROM purchase_requests pr JOIN users applicant ON applicant.id = pr.applicant_id JOIN departments department ON department.id = pr.department_id LEFT JOIN suppliers supplier ON supplier.id = pr.requested_supplier_id LEFT JOIN request_approval_decisions ad ON ad.request_id = pr.id AND ad.decision = 'APPROVED' LEFT JOIN purchase_orders po ON po.request_id = pr.id JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT (ARRAY_AGG(ri.product_name ORDER BY ri.line_number))[1] AS product_name, COUNT(*)::INTEGER AS item_count, SUM(ri.quantity::BIGINT * ri.planned_unit_price)::BIGINT AS planned_total, SUM(ri.quantity::BIGINT * poi.actual_unit_price)::BIGINT AS actual_total FROM request_items ri LEFT JOIN purchase_order_items poi ON poi.request_item_id = ri.id WHERE ri.request_id = pr.id ) summary ON TRUE WHERE
ORDER BY COALESCE(ad.decided_at, pr.updated_at) ASC, pr.id ASC
ORDER BY COALESCE(ad.decided_at, pr.updated_at) DESC, pr.id DESC
ORDER BY (CASE WHEN po.id IS NULL THEN summary.planned_total ELSE summary.actual_total END) DESC, pr.id ASC
ORDER BY pr.desired_delivery_date ASC NULLS LAST, COALESCE(ad.decided_at, pr.updated_at) ASC, pr.id ASC
LIMIT #{criteria.limit} OFFSET #{criteria.offset}

SELECT pr.id AS request_id, pr.request_number, pr.status, pr.title, pr.reason, pr.desired_delivery_date, pr.note, pr.applicant_id, applicant.display_name AS applicant_name, pr.department_id, COALESCE(pr.department_name_snapshot, department.name) AS department_name, pr.requested_supplier_id, COALESCE(pr.requested_supplier_name_snapshot, requested_supplier.name) AS requested_supplier_name, COALESCE(ad.decided_at, pr.updated_at) AS approved_at, po.id AS purchase_order_id, po.actual_supplier_id, po.actual_supplier_name_snapshot AS actual_supplier_name, po.purchase_order_number, po.promised_delivery_date, po.purchaser_note, ordered_by.display_name AS ordered_by_name, po.ordered_at, receipt.received_date, receipt.receipt_note, received_by.display_name AS received_by_name, receipt.completed_at, pr.version FROM purchase_requests pr JOIN users applicant ON applicant.id = pr.applicant_id JOIN departments department ON department.id = pr.department_id LEFT JOIN suppliers requested_supplier ON requested_supplier.id = pr.requested_supplier_id LEFT JOIN request_approval_decisions ad ON ad.request_id = pr.id AND ad.decision = 'APPROVED' LEFT JOIN purchase_orders po ON po.request_id = pr.id LEFT JOIN users ordered_by ON ordered_by.id = po.ordered_by LEFT JOIN request_receipts receipt ON receipt.purchase_order_id = po.id LEFT JOIN users received_by ON received_by.id = receipt.received_by WHERE pr.id = #{requestId} AND pr.status IN ('APPROVED', 'ORDERED', 'COMPLETED')

SELECT ri.id AS request_item_id, ri.line_number, ri.product_name, ri.model_number, ri.product_url, ri.category_id, category.name AS category_name, ri.quantity, ri.planned_unit_price, poi.actual_unit_price FROM request_items ri LEFT JOIN categories category ON category.id = ri.category_id LEFT JOIN purchase_order_items poi ON poi.request_item_id = ri.id JOIN purchase_requests pr ON pr.id = ri.request_id WHERE ri.request_id = #{requestId} AND pr.status IN ('APPROVED', 'ORDERED', 'COMPLETED') ORDER BY ri.line_number
